wikipedia.title: Eubank Landfill Solar Array
wikipedia.extract: The Eubank Landfill Solar Array is a photovoltaic power station in Albuquerque, New Mexico that consists of 1.0 MWAC of concentrator photovoltaics (CPV) and 1.0 MWAC of flat-panel silicon photovoltaics (PV).  It is the only utility-scale CPV system utilizing Suncore third-generation technology that is operational and grid-connected in the US.   A portion of the output is being sold to PNM under a Power Purchase Agreement.
